name: Gridiron Grading overall prospect score: production + athleticism + film (grade bands)
census_status: EXTERNAL-REFERENCE — the authors' published scoring system, held as a method record; class instances live in the public datasets at C-320 (recorded, not downloaded)
stamp_required: prospect production + athletic testing + film grades by draft class
stamp_gap: the system definition is fully published by the authors and held here; the per-prospect scores sit in the C-320 datasets, which were not downloaded in this tranche

record.source: X account @GridironGrading deep-scroll catalog (~85 analytical posts over 12 months), read 2026-10-15
record.data_source_credit: authors' own model (Production / Athleticism / Film components); athletic component is the authors' own model, distinct from RAS
record.formula: Overall Prospect Score = Production Score + Athleticism Score + Film Score (each component percentile-based)

components.name: Athleticism Score (GG)
components.definition: the authors' own athleticism model — explicitly distinct from RAS, which is a different published system; the two are not interchangeable

record.age_adjustment: applied — younger prospects receive a bump (authors' stated method)
method_notes: authors' stated correlation benchmarks: 0.6+ is good; most positions run closer to 0.4 — recorded as their calibration honesty, in their terms
for interior defensive line, the two most predictive inputs are True Pass Set Win % and Run Defense Grade (authors' stated finding)
Career Zone Y/RR at the 3.0+ tier has, in the authors' words, a 'really strong hit rate'
record.role: draft-lane method reference: a fully published, three-component prospect grading system whose realized outcomes are checkable against C-319 (Impact Score) and the C-320 datasets
